description: This file is a Perl module named 'appveyor' that interacts with the AppVeyor CI service API. It provides functions to check the environment, create test results, and update test outcomes, primarily for integrating test reporting with AppVeyor.

methods.name: appveyor_check_environment
methods.description: Checks if the script is running inside AppVeyor CI environment by verifying the environment variable 'APPVEYOR_API_URL'.

methods.name: appveyor_create_test_result
methods.description: Creates a new test result entry in AppVeyor with 'Running' outcome, storing the test name and related data.

methods.name: appveyor_update_test_result
methods.description: Updates an existing test result in AppVeyor with the outcome, duration, and error message based on test execution.
